notes: The EC-SORT-MERGE-FILE-OPEN of an open USING/GIVING file is set to exist and "the results of the execution of the SORT statement are undefined" (§2002:14.8.36.3 GR8a, GR8c; cite.py --check); the condition is Fatal (§2002 Table 14), so §2002:14.5.12.1.2 decides the run unit: with checking enabled the declarative runs and "If execution of the declarative completes normally the execution of the run unit is terminated abnormally" (item 2). There is no 2002 item for a MERGE or SORT statement (§2023:14.6.13.1.3 2) is new in 2023), so at --std 2002 the SORT guard does not hand the marked condition to the verb: DialectBehavior.SortMergeStatementDisposesItsFatalConditions (VCR row 7.80, kb/Work PB5612). The golden prints the declarative and ends the run unit; the 2002 twin of the 2023 rule (GR-14.9.40.4-9) is witnessed at 2014 and 2023 by pb5612_sort_file_open_fatal_by_edition.
